Predict from a fitted PINN

Source: R/methods.R
predict.pinn_fit.Rd

Evaluates the trained network at new points.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'pinn_fit'
predict(object, newdata = NULL, ...)

Arguments

object

A pinn_fit.

newdata

Data frame with one column per domain variable. When omitted, the times given to pinn_ode() are used for ODE problems, and otherwise a regular grid (201 points in 1D, 101 x 101 in 2D).

...

Unused.

Value

A data frame with the domain variables followed by one column per output.

Examples

decay <- function(t, y, parms) list(-parms["k"] * y)
prob <- pinn_ode(decay, y0 = c(y = 1), times = c(0, 5), parms = c(k = 0.5))
fit <- pinn_fit(prob, hidden = c(16, 16), epochs = 1000, seed = 1)
predict(fit, data.frame(time = c(0, 1, 2)))
#>   time         y
#> 1    0 1.0000000
#> 2    1 0.6344568
#> 3    2 0.3608426
